scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @todo/api && npm run build -w @todo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @todo/api && npm run typecheck -w @todo/web && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web 'npm run dev -w @todo/api' 'npm run dev -w @todo/web'
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web 'npm run start -w @todo/api' 'npm run start -w @todo/web'
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @todo/api && tsx --test apps/web/test/*.test.ts
